prepare_model_for_moe_quantization: prepare a HuggingFace model for MOE quantization by unfusing fused expert weights into per-expert Linear layers
register_linear_loop_experts: register the linear_loop experts implementation with transformers for use with quantized MOE models
linear_loop_experts_forward: run a forward pass through MOE experts using individual Linear layers per expert instead of fused 3D parameters
is_linear_loop_available: check if the linear_loop experts implementation is available in the current transformers version
unfuse_experts_weights_inplace: unfuse fused 3D expert weight parameters into per-expert nn.Linear containers in place
